statutory_act: LMPC Rules, 2011 read with Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 (Cosmetics Rules, 2020)

cosmetic_mfg_license.description: Manufacturing license number issued by State Drug Controller / CDSCO.
cosmetic_mfg_license.statutory_citation: Cosmetics Rules, 2020 Rule 34: The manufacturing licence number under which the cosmetic is manufactured preceded by 'M.L. No.' or 'Mfg. Lic. No.'
cosmetic_mfg_license.remedy: Unlicensed cosmetic seizure under Drugs & Cosmetics Act & LMPC.

batch_lot_number.description: A distinctive batch number preceded by letter 'B' or 'Batch No.' or 'Lot No.'
batch_lot_number.statutory_citation: Cosmetics Rules: A distinctive batch number, being the number by reference to which details of manufacture, can be traced.

use_before_date.rule_title: Use Before / Expiry Date (Use Before / Exp)
use_before_date.description: Date of expiry or 'Use before' date for cosmetics with shelf life less than or equal to 36 months.
use_before_date.statutory_citation: Cosmetics Rules, 2020: The month and year of manufacture and the date of expiry (month and year) must be stated.

ingredients_declaration.description: List of all ingredients in descending order of concentration or INCI nomenclature.
ingredients_declaration.statutory_citation: Cosmetics Rules 2020: Every cosmetic package shall carry a declaration of ingredients using INCI or common names.
